snippet.title: High Times Developer Commentary Trailer - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
This exclusive developer commentary from Yangyang Mobile introduces you to High Times, a game where you help customers escape from their problems by serving special donuts that affect their emotions. Sometimes they don't know what they want, so listen to their stories, offer them advice in the form of donuts, and mend broken relationships. Inspired by Scott Pilgrim, VA-11 Hall-A, Papa's Donuteria and Good Pizza Great Pizza.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251220
